svg.text: What you see in VS Code
The Workspaces Console, in plain words
Results open here, in plain words, with buttons for what to do next.
A command that changes something shows you the change first
Learn a Topic: the same pages as ws-host help, every step a button
Problems panel: findings, with a click to go to the place
Status bar: is your machine well, and how many things need you? Click it to open Home
